reconstruction.NOTES: Real semantic privilege difference: the sealed restored baseline has owner-only default ACL; live also grants USAGE to anon, authenticated and service_role, plus postgres USAGE WITH GRANT OPTION. The archive has CREATE/OWNER schema metadata but no top-level GRANT/REVOKE for these schemas. Direct bridge/0012 functions do not use GraphQL, but this changes a security boundary and must not be silently accepted.

The archive has CREATE/OWNER schema metadata but no top-level GRANT/REVOKE for these schemas. Live role explicitly defaults transactions to READ ONLY; restored role has no setting and an actual local login defaults to READ WRITE. Source role-settings metadata omitted this key. This is a real operational safeguard difference; live is stricter than the sealed restore baseline.

Real ownership difference: restore creates this extension as supabase_admin; live owner is postgres. Archive CREATE EXTENSION statements carry no owner restoration. Extension version and schema match. Ownership is administrative authority, even though no direct bridge RPC or RLS definition differs.

normalization.acl: PostgreSQL aclexplode tuples sorted by stable JSON; preserve object identity, grantee, grantor, privilege and grant option
normalization.role_config: Unique key order only; duplicate keys fail
normalization.timeout: Only supabase_auth_admin idle_in_transaction_session_timeout; exact nonnegative integer milliseconds
normalization.logging: Only three audited admin roles: explicit none or proven inherited none. Reject database overrides and session/client/user-sourced fallback. Canonical effective none remains in fingerprint.
normalization.unchanged: All owners, role attributes, other GUCs, RLS, policies, function signatures/definitions/search_path and non-normalized catalog inputs remain exact.

authFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.email()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.email', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'email')
  )::text
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.jwt()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
    coalesce(
        nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim', true), ''),
        nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')
    )::jsonb
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role')
  )::text
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$
